 7 die of dengue, 1,872 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll now 342 
 Published : 17 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 17 October 2026, 18:26
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least seven dengue patients died while 1,872 others were hospitalised, in the last 24 hours till today morning.
 Of the deaths, three were in Dhaka division, three in Dhaka city, and one Mymensingh division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the new deaths and cases, the total number of deaths rose to 342 and the number of cases to 1,10,312.
 Currently 5,771 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at different hospitals across the country.
